subject: Invitation to our Annual Charity Gala
body: Dear valued supporter, We are delighted to invite you to our annual charity gala event, which will be held at the Grand Ballroom on December 15th. Join us for an elegant evening of fine dining, live music, and a silent auction to raise funds for our cause. Your presence and support will make a meaningful difference in the lives of those in need. Please RSVP by November 30th. We look forward to seeing you there! Warm regards, The Charity Foundation Team
